name: What documents do I need to prepare before starting a 1031 exchange process?

mainEntity.name: What documents do I need to prepare before starting a 1031 exchange process?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before initiating a 1031 exchange, you should gather documentation related to your relinquished property, including purchase records, depreciation schedules, and any improvement costs to help determine your basis. You'll also need clear identification of the property's titleholders. Having these details ready helps streamline discussions with your Qualified Intermediary and our team as we prepare to list your property and search for new opportunities in locations like West Palm Beach or Delray Beach, ensuring a smoother process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare purchase records, depreciation schedules, improvement costs, and titleholder information for your relinquished property before starting a 1031 exchange.
